clips.summary: The player moves horizontally while firing continuous small shots and periodic large diamond projectiles, transitioning from Sector 4 to Sector 5 (Last Approach) and clearing waves of small red, yellow, green, and white enemies.

events.player_action: Moves right while holding continuous fire
events.hit: Hexagonal white enemy and small red-outlined oval enemies
events.visual: Bright white flash and expanding white ring where the enemy was

events.player_action: Moves left and fires a large elongated white diamond projectile
events.visual: White diamond streaks up with trailing rings, enemies vanish in white flashes

events.player_action: Holds continuous fire while centered
events.hit: Two hexagonal white enemies at the top
events.visual: Twin bright white flashes
events.sound: No distinct hit sound heard over the synth music

events.player_action: Fires a large diamond projectile straight up
events.hit: Hexagonal white enemy behind the title text
events.visual: Expanding white ring and flash

events.player_action: Moves left while holding continuous fire
events.hit: Green diamond-shaped enemy on the left
events.visual: Small white flash

events.player_action: Slow, precise movement on the left (dark core reticle visible on ship) while firing continuously
events.visual: Enemy flashes and disappears

events.player_action: Moves to center, fires a large blast
events.visual: Large concentric white/gold rings around player and multiple enemy flashes

events.player_action: Moves up slightly then down while firing continuously
events.hit: Yellow V-shaped enemy and hexagonal enemy
events.visual: White flashes and expanding ring

weak_or_ambiguous.issue: Two enemies flash brightly at the top of the lane, but there is no clear audio cue for their destruction over the background music.
Large 'SECTOR 5 Last Approach' text overlays the center of the playfield right over incoming enemies and bullets, obscuring hits.

onscreen_text: SECTOR 4 Lancer Gate -> SECTOR 5 Last Approach

clips.summary: The player weaves between small red-outlined enemies in Sector 1, using a forward scanning cone and slow-movement mode without firing main weapons, taking a hit near the end.

events.player_action: Moves left with a forward blue cone active, not firing
events.hit: None (cone sweeps over red-outlined oval enemies)
events.visual: White brackets/reticle spin around an enemy

events.player_action: Hovers on the right, keeping an enemy inside the blue cone
events.visual: 'Codex: Scout' banner pops up at top; 'PATROL' label appears next to enemy
events.sound: No distinct sound effect heard over the music

events.player_action: Switches to slow/precise movement (ship turns into a white orb with dark center and four black corner brackets) moving left
events.visual: Ship appearance changes to high-contrast orb

events.player_action: Moves right in slow mode into a pink bullet/enemy
events.visual: Entire screen border flashes red, HULL meter in top right drops from 5 to 4 pink blocks

weak_or_ambiguous.issue: Completing the scan ('Codex: Scout' popup) has no audible chime or confirmation sound.

clips.summary: In Sector 1, the player fires large charged diamond shots and single bursts at small red-outlined enemies while dodging bullets.

events.player_action: Fires a large white diamond projectile straight up while on the left
events.hit: Misses enemies to the left, passes through empty lane
events.visual: Bright elongated diamond with concentric rings travels up

events.player_action: Moves up-left and fires a small shot
events.visual: Bright white flash on the left

events.player_action: Moves left and fires a large projectile at close range
events.visual: Expanding ring and white flash

events.player_action: Moves left and fires another large white diamond projectile
events.hit: Misses the group of enemies on the right
events.visual: Diamond projectile streaks up the left side with trailing rings

events.player_action: Moves from center to left, firing a large shot
events.hit: Small red-outlined enemy in the lower center
events.visual: White flash as enemy disappears

weak_or_ambiguous.issue: The sound for firing the large diamond projectile is nearly identical whether it hits an enemy (at 4.3s, 9.6s) or misses completely (at 0.4s, 6.4s), making hit confirmation by audio alone difficult.

onscreen_text: LENS CONTROL: Lens Centering is down. Partial deliverable. Rate adjusted.

clips.summary: The player battles a large heart-shaped boss ('WARDEN') in Sector 6, scanning it while weaving through curved waves of pink and yellow bullets using slow movement.

events.player_action: Moves from left to center at start of boss phase
events.visual: Red dome over the boss disappears, revealing a gold/red heart-shaped core
events.sound: Music plays, no distinct shield-drop sound

events.player_action: Switches to slow movement (white orb with black center), dodging right then left through pink bullet arcs while keeping blue scan cone on boss
events.visual: 'CORE' label with brackets appears on the tip of the heart boss

events.player_action: Continues slow movement on the left, firing a single small diamond shot
events.hit: Hits the bottom tip ('CORE') of the heart boss
events.visual: 'Codex: The Warden's core' banner appears; white ring expands around player

events.player_action: Moves left in slow mode while boss fires a dense spiral of pink and yellow bullets
events.visual: Boss flashes brightly at its center as it emits bullets

weak_or_ambiguous.issue: A loud metallic screech plays right as 'Codex: The Warden's core' pops up and a small shot hits the boss, making it ambiguous whether the sound is a scan completion cue, a hit sound, or a boss attack telegraph.

clips.summary: The player moves rapidly across the lane in Sector 1, firing single small shots to pick off red-outlined enemies while taking one hit.

events.player_action: Moves from left to right, firing a single small white projectile
events.hit: Red-outlined enemy in the upper middle
events.visual: Enemy vanishes with a small white flash and expanding ring

events.player_action: Moves left into an enemy or bullet
events.hit: Player ship is hit and enemy is destroyed
events.visual: Screen edges flash red, HULL drops from 5 to 4 blocks, SCORE increases to 200

events.player_action: Fires a single small shot from the left
events.hit: Red-outlined enemy near the top left
events.visual: Expanding white ring and flash

events.player_action: Moves to center, fires a single shot
events.visual: Small flash

events.player_action: Moves right, fires a single shot
events.visual: Faint ring expansion

events.player_action: Moves left, fires a single shot at close range
events.visual: Pink/white ring around player, enemy disappears

events.player_action: Moves right, scans and shoots an enemy
events.visual: Concentric white rings around the enemy, then it vanishes

weak_or_ambiguous.issue: When the enemy in the center is hit, the visual flash is very small and covered by the blue scan cone arc.

onscreen_text: SCOUT CHANNEL: Drift Two is dark. Drift Two is DARK.

clips.summary: In Sector 4, the player uses continuous fire, a large diamond shot, and slow movement to fight green diamond enemies and white hexagonal enemies amid dense pink bullet patterns.

events.player_action: Moves left while holding continuous rapid fire
events.visual: Bright white flash and expanding ring on the enemy
events.sound: Rapid light ticking followed by a crisp pop

events.player_action: Enters slow movement on the left while firing continuously
events.visual: White flash

events.player_action: Fires a large white diamond projectile up the left side
events.hit: Misses the two hexagonal enemies in the center
events.visual: Diamond projectile streaks off the top of the screen

events.player_action: Moves to center while holding continuous fire
events.hit: Two hexagonal white enemies at the top center
events.visual: Expanding white ring and bright flash on the right hexagonal enemy, then the left

events.player_action: Weaves slightly in slow mode at the bottom center while holding continuous fire through a dense curtain of pink bullets
events.hit: Two hexagonal enemies and green enemies in the upper middle
events.visual: Multiple white flashes at the top of the bullet curtain

weak_or_ambiguous.issue: The large diamond shot misses everything, yet produces the same loud impact-like blast sound as when it hits targets.

onscreen_text: SCAN - DART: Both emitters painted. It knows exactly where to listen.

clips.summary: In Sector 1, the player moves horizontally while firing continuous streams of small white bullets at red-outlined oval enemies, taking one hit early on.

events.player_action: Moves right while holding continuous fire
events.visual: Small white flash

events.player_action: Moves left while firing continuously
events.visual: Small white flash

events.player_action: Collides with a descending red-outlined enemy/bullet in the lower center
events.hit: Player ship is hit and enemy is destroyed
events.visual: Screen flashes red, pink ring expands around player, HULL drops from 5 to 4

events.player_action: Moves right while holding continuous fire
events.hit: Two red-outlined enemies in the upper center
events.visual: Sequential small white flashes

events.player_action: Moves right while holding continuous fire
events.visual: Small white flash

events.player_action: Moves left while holding continuous fire
events.hit: Two red-outlined enemies on the left side
events.visual: Enemies flash and vanish; pink ring appears around player

events.player_action: Fires continuously on the left
events.visual: Small white flash

weak_or_ambiguous.issue: Continuous firing has almost no audible firing sound of its own; only the enemy death pops are clearly heard over the music.

onscreen_text: SCOUT CHANNEL: Drift Two is dark. Drift Two is DARK.

clips.summary: The player engages the heart-shaped boss ('WARDEN') in Sector 6, firing large pulses at the start and later hitting both the boss and small spawned enemies while dodging in slow mode.

events.player_action: Triggers a massive expanding ring pulse in the center
events.visual: Huge bright white/blue ring expands across the whole lane
events.sound: Rapid rhythmic synth percussion, no distinct explosion sound

events.player_action: Triggers a second massive expanding ring pulse
events.visual: Huge bright white/blue ring expands across the lane
events.sound: No distinct explosion sound over the music

events.player_action: Moves left in slow mode and fires a medium white ring projectile upward
events.hit: Hits the bottom left edge of the heart boss
events.visual: White ring projectile travels up and disappears against the boss; boss health bar decreases slightly

events.player_action: Moves right in slow mode and fires/triggers a bright flash
events.hit: Right side of the heart boss and a small enemy
events.visual: Large bright heart-shaped white flash over the right side of the boss; SCORE jumps from 0 to 100

events.player_action: Moves left in slow mode while scanning a small red-outlined enemy ('PATROL') below the boss
events.hit: Small enemy is scanned and destroyed, boss is hit
events.visual: 'Codex: Scout' and 'Codex: The Warden's core' pop up; bright flash near player
events.sound: Loud metallic screech followed by a crisp pop at 13.0s

weak_or_ambiguous.issue: The massive screen-filling ring pulses at 0.2s and 2.0s have tremendous visual impact but zero audible sound effect.
The boss flashes bright white and the score increases by 100, which actually came from destroying a small spawned Scout enemy hidden behind the boss flash, making it unclear what was hit.
